DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODUCT_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_product_information is
 temp_status_ind VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_number VARCHAR2(20) := '';
 temp_date date;
 last_item varchar2(9) := 'NONE';
 temp_blood_type varchar2(10);
 cursor c1 is
 select product_code, aliquot, from_date,
 decode(status_ind,'AL',1,'PK',2,'SH',3,'XR',4,'DL',5,'RT',6,'QU',7,'RP',8,'OD',9,
 'DI',10,'IL',11,'CK',12,'AV',13,14),
 status_ind, shipped_to, blood_type
 from product_history
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 UNION
 select product_code, component_prefix aliquot,
 insert_dats from_date, 0, 'CM' status_ind,
 '' shipped_to, system_label_decision blood_type
 from components
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 order by 1, 2, 3 desc, 4 desc, 5;
begin
 go_block('products_info');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 if (last_item != c1_rec.product_code||c1_rec.aliquot AND NVL(length(c1_rec.product_code), 0) = '5')
 OR (last_item != c1_rec.product_code AND NVL(length(c1_rec.product_code), 0) = '8')
 then
 :product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :aliquot := c1_rec.aliquot;
 temp_status_ind := c1_rec.status_ind;

 IF NVL(length(c1_rec.product_code), 0) = '5' THEN
 last_item := c1_rec.product_code||c1_rec.aliquot;
 ELSE
 last_item := c1_rec.product_code;
 END IF;
 begin
 
 temp_blood_type:=c1_rec.blood_type;
 
 -- the below if condition was added for SCR: 152095 on 1/5/18
 If temp_blood_type is null then
 begin
 select blood_type into temp_blood_type from product_history where
 unit_id=:unit_id and product_code=c1_rec.product_code and blood_type is not null
 and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 temp_blood_type:=null;
 end;
 End if;
 
 --Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc
 into :s_abo_code_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = temp_blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I');
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_product_status
 from vserv_master
 where code_type = 'SKSTS'
 and code = temp_status_ind
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if temp_status_ind = 'DI'
 then
 :s_disposition := 'Discarded';
 elsif temp_status_ind = 'CK'
 then
 :s_disposition := 'Discard Bin';
 elsif temp_status_ind in ('IL','CM')
 then
 :s_disposition := 'In Lab';
 elsif temp_status_ind in ('DL','SH','XR')
 then
 begin
 select max(shipped_date) into temp_date
 from shipped_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and shipped_to = c1_rec.shipped_to;
 select inventory_class, short_name, shipment_no
 into :s_inven_class, :s_disposition, temp_number
 from consignee c, shipped_products sp
 where consignee_id = c1_rec.shipped_to
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and sp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and sp.shipped_to = c1_rec.shipped_to
 and to_char(shipped_date,'mm-dd-yy hh24:mi:ss') =
 to_char(temp_date,'mm-dd-yy hh24:mi:ss');
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error in querying consignee');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select inventory_class
 into :s_inven_class
 from active_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error in querying from active');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_status_ind in ('AV','OD')
 then
 :s_disposition := 'In Stock';
 elsif temp_status_ind = 'QU'
 then
 :s_disposition := 'Quarantine Bin';
 elsif temp_status_ind = 'RT'
 then
 :s_disposition := 'Returned';
 elsif temp_status_ind in ('AL','WO','PK','RP')
 then
 begin
 select pick_slip_id, box_id
 into temp_number, :s_disposition
 from pick_slip_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 and product_status = temp_status_ind;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error querying pick slip prod-1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_number is not null
 then
 get_order_number(temp_number,temp_status_ind);
 end if;
 get_expiration;
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 :s_indicator := '>';
 synchronize;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
